statements.proposition: Running pytest -q at the head commit gives 1 passed and 3 skipped, the skips being because ruby dependencies are not installed
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Reproduced the exact counts in a venv (pytest, meshtastic) with the sandbox denying network, so bundle install fails and the three ruby-dependent tests skip with 'ruby dependencies not installed'. The skipped tests were not run with a working Ruby bundle, so whether they would pass is not settled (the statement does not claim they do).
evidence: python3 sbx.py --dir checkout -- .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q at head d4e57a5: '.sss ... 1 passed, 3 skipped in 0.55s'
test/test_web_app.py calls pytest.skip('ruby dependencies not installed') when bundle install/exec fails; 3 tests there plus 1 in test_nodes_serialization.py = 4 total
